test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Change the following from active to passive:**

People believe that the company will launch the new product before the end of this fiscal year.

options.text: The company believes to launch the product before the end of the fiscal year.
The new product is believed to be launched before the fiscal year ends.
It has been believed that the new product will launch this year.
It is believed that the company will launch the new product before the end of this fiscal year.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "People believe that the company will launch the new product before the end of this fiscal year."
 
• To convert to passive voice: The phrase "People believe that" is transformed into "It is believed that" to maintain grammatical correctness.
 
• The rest of the sentence structure remains unchanged to retain the original meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The company believes to launch the product before the end of the fiscal year." – Incorrect because it changes the subject and meaning of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2: **"The new product is believed to be launched before the fiscal year ends." – Incorrect because it alters the tense and structure.
 
• **Option 3: **"It has been believed that the new product will launch this year." – Incorrect because it changes the tense and time frame.
